responsibility: Provides the autogenerated mapping from AIX 32/64-bit rs6000 option names in gcc/config/rs6000/aix64.opt to their GCC manual URL suffixes. It is the documentation companion for the AIX bi-arch option table, covering switches such as width selection, AIX code-model controls, and related aliases, so option help or generated metadata can link those AIX-specific options to the correct manual locations.
